quotes.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 27, 2026 be above $0.85?

Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

quotes.title: Will there be at least 10 presidential nominations sent to the Senate in the week of Nov 22, 2026?
quotes.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has sent at least 10 nominations to the U.S. Senate from Nov 22, 2026 through Nov 28, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 29, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
quotes.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 29, 2026.
The week runs from Nov 22, 2026 through Nov 28, 2026.

Payout criteria

If a person receives multiple qualifying nominations within the period, they will each count separately.
For example, Trump's March 4 nomination of Kevin Warsh (https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/03/nominations-sent-to-the-senate-b376/) is considered two nominations.
